note: Diagnostic et mesures locales du correctif du crash CI ; fichiers bruts de reference dans les logs cites. Ce n-est pas une mesure CI directe (pas d-acces aux logs du runner), le symptome CI est celui du run 42543351768.

ci_symptom.runner: GitHub Actions, Windows Server 2025, 4 vCPU, 7 Go

root_cause.classification: test defect (not UB, not harness, not stack overflow)
root_cause.mechanism: std::process::abort() from a wall-clock 45 s watchdog (Windows abort -> __fastfail -> 0xC0000409)
chain: both publisher threads ran the same candidate sequence in lockstep
the winner published, the loser got AlreadyActive, both retried the same candidate, repeat
loser exhausted 64 retries -> assert!(activated) panic at line 1100
publisher join panicked at line 1140, scope unwound, render thread still looped on publishers_done=false
wall watchdog fired after 45 s and aborted the process
root_cause.why_ci_only: local scheduling jitter broke the lockstep after a few attempts; the slower 4 vCPU runner kept both threads synchronized enough that the loser never won a race
root_cause.harness_not_involved: ArcSlot/BlockHost/reclaimer unchanged; patch-host M3 tests and the other 8 stress scenarios never failed

fix.deterministic_phases: publisher 0 starts with gain_v2, publisher 1 with gain_v1; after a rejection the next attempt targets the other artifact, which cannot be active then
fix.no_thread_panic: publisher_loop returns Result; the main thread panics once, after the render loop is stopped
fix.stop_on_drop: guard sets publishers_done=true on unwind so the scope join cannot hang
fix.progress_watchdog: abort only if the (blocks + activations) progress counter does not move for 30 s; wall-clock 45 s timeout removed
fix.cooperative_render: yield_now() per rendered block so a 4 vCPU runner still schedules the publishers
fix.ci_work_budget: 10 000 swaps kept; concurrent invariant kept at 4 000 successful activations and whole-version blocks; 10k loop uses generated ~9 KiB no_std modules because the mandatory artifact hash dominated (31.2 s -> 3.0 s)

four_cpu_simulated.command: ProcessorAffinity=0xF on the test process, dsp_stress.exe <test> --nocapture --test-threads=1

full_suite_under_load.command: CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 cargo test -p ravum-dsp-harness --test dsp_stress -- --nocapture --test-threads=1 (2 busy-loop PowerShell)

invariants_kept: 2 concurrent publishers and 4 000 successful activations in the version-race scenario
no mixed-version block observed (15 093 167 blocks during the races)
0 allocation / 0 deallocation on the render thread for the measured blocks
whole-version block rule and retired-module guard rule unchanged
limits: local measurements only: no direct access to the CI runner logs; the CI symptom is the one reported in run 42543351768
the machine is shared with other agents; durations are indicative margins, not throughput claims
a genuine deadlock still aborts the process after 30 s without progress (hard bound, not a graceful recovery)
in-memory block host only: no audio device, no real-time priority, no XRUN, no hard real-time claim
